reasoning_summary: Selected features prioritize stable, interpretable credit-risk signals with zero missingness and broad coverage. Redundancy is controlled by preferring representative aggregates (e.g., fico_mean over fico_range_low/high) and avoiding multiple near-duplicate bands unless they add distinct interpretability. Features with potential leakage or unstable operational proxies were excluded. The selection covers diverse semantic groups including income_capacity, repayment behavior, and other application-level variables, ensuring broad semantic coverage and defensibility in scorecard reviews.
